audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradict the sentence printed under them. whys[0] gives Level 1 to Yorick (row says Skill); whys[1] and whys[2] call 2 and 3 even (rows say Yorick); whys[3] and whys[4] give 4-5 and 6 to Yorick (rows say Skill); whys[6] calls 2+ items even (row says Yorick).
audit.why: The packet chart matches the prose exactly, so the rows are simply stale. The mirror never touched the chart, so nothing here fights it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 -> Yorick, rows 1, 2 -> Skill, row 6 -> Skill, as matched full/content pairs in one group; row 0's rating raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage said his ultimate does little to you without giving its cooldown, so the reader cannot tell how long the window lasts.
audit.why: Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90s and does knock up and slow — it is weak as a duel button, not harmless. The engage cooldown that actually gates your commit is Elastic Slingshot at 21/18/15/12/9s.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now carries the ultimate's real cooldown and dosFull[0].d the Slingshot's, giving the 'wait for X before you Y' line the packet says is missing everywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names are wrong — 'Stretching Strike' (it is Stretching Strikes) and 'Let's Bounce' (it is Let's Bounce!). Three applicable interactions never reached the page: Cell Division's blobs as his sustain engine, Unstable Matter dealing percent max health, and Stretching Strikes being an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q grabs at 800 range on 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s and resets his auto; W is a 5s, 350-range percent-max-health explosion, so stacking armour reads the trade wrong; the passive sheds a reabsorbable chunk every time an ability hits, which is what wins him extended trades.
audit.corrected: Both names fixed; the do/don't bodies now state the blob denial, the percent-health W, the Q grab numbers and the E landing knockup.

edits.before: Zac's early trades lean on Stretching Strike (Q) to pull you and Elastic Slingshot (E) engage, but he's low-damage and passive-blob reliant early. Level 4 is a spike for you — cage him with W as he lands his E, slow with Mourning Mist, and ghouls plus Maiden out-DPS his squishy laning. Step on his passive blobs to deny the heal.
edits.after: Zac's early trades lean on Stretching Strikes (Q), an 800-range grab on 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, plus the Elastic Slingshot engage — but he is low-damage and blob-reliant. Level 4 is your spike: cage him with W as he lands his E, slow with Mourning Mist, and ghouls plus Maiden out-DPS him. Walk over every blob to deny the heal.

edits.before: Let's Bounce (R) is a teamfight ult, not a duel button, so it does little to you 1v1 in lane. This is your window — with Maiden up and ghouls stacked you shove and out-sustain him hard; Zac just farms and waits for objectives. Zone him off the wave with your cage.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! (R) knocks up and slows on a 120/105/90s cooldown, but it is a teamfight tool rather than a duel button. This is your window — with Maiden up and ghouls stacked you shove and out-sustain him; Zac farms and waits for objectives. Zone him off the wave with the cage.
